probe_finding: The 150-run campaign's nominal magnitudes (ir_decoy 6.0 deg, rf_jam 4.0 deg az) are NOT members of the swept set {0.1, 0.2, 0.35, 0.6, 1.5, 4.0}; the ir_decoy nominal exceeds the largest swept point. Both nominal magnitudes sit far above the ~0.36 deg noise floor, so '100% detection' is TRUE for the campaign and is not contradicted by the sweep. The defect is omission: the prose does not carry the floor its own table reports. Status TRUE_BUT_AMBIGUOUS, not FALSE.
recommended_claim: 100% detection (100/100 runs) at the campaign magnitudes, with a measured detection floor: detection falls to 0.50 at 0.2 deg and 0.00 at 0.1 deg, consistent with a combined bearing-noise floor near 0.36 deg. Synthetic sensor models; not validated against seeker hardware.
